objects.name: Price-Implied Expectations
objects.purpose: Infer the operating and value-capture expectations already embedded in current market price while keeping the capability identity independent of any single valuation algorithm.
objects.output_contract: Price-implied operating expectations, assumption surface, expectation-gap state, uncertainty and falsifiers. Reverse DCF may be one algorithm; target price is prohibited.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2.3 successor identity; R3A/R4 implementation and benchmark execution remain separately governed

objects.name: Growth-Optimal Risk Budget under Uncertainty
objects.purpose: Evaluate the growth-versus-survival risk-budget problem under estimation uncertainty and explicit survival constraints without binding the capability identity to a single Kelly implementation or issuing recommended position sizes.
objects.output_contract: Growth/survival tradeoff diagnostics, uncertainty sensitivity and admissible risk-budget research state under declared constraints; no recommended weight, position size or live sizing action.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2.3 successor identity; deterministic implementation and benchmark execution remain separately governed
